Here is the issue description:
# stream_register: Error in Synopsys Synplify
Hi all,
I'm facing a problem using the stream_register required for using Pulp AXI. This module is included in the axi_atop_filter. Unfortunately I get the following error message during compilation with Synopsys Synplify :
**@E: CD671: /.../commom_cells/src/stream_register.sv: 36:31:36:31| Expecting array type.**
If I change the code from
```
fifo_v2 #(
.FALL_THROUGH   (1'b0),
.DATA_WIDTH     ($size(T)),                     // <= change done here: $size() replaced with $bits()
.DEPTH          (1),
.dtype          (T)
) i_fifo (
.clk_i          (clk_i),
.rst_ni         (rst_ni),
.flush_i        (clr_i),
.testmode_i     (testmode_i),
.full_o         (fifo_full),
.empty_o        (fifo_empty),
.alm_full_o     ( ),
.alm_empty_o    ( ),
.data_i         (data_i),
.push_i         (valid_i & ~fifo_full),
.data_o         (data_o),
.pop_i          (ready_i & ~fifo_empty)
);
```
to
```
fifo_v2 #(
.FALL_THROUGH   (1'b0),
.DATA_WIDTH     ($bits(T)),                    // <= this is working
.DEPTH          (1),
.dtype          (T)
) i_fifo (
.clk_i          (clk_i),
.rst_ni         (rst_ni),
.flush_i        (clr_i),
.testmode_i     (testmode_i),
.full_o         (fifo_full),
.empty_o        (fifo_empty),
.alm_full_o     ( ),
.alm_empty_o    ( ),
.data_i         (data_i),
.push_i         (valid_i & ~fifo_full),
.data_o         (data_o),
.pop_i          (ready_i & ~fifo_empty)
);
```
but I think then the module does not have the intended behaviour any more. Does anybody know what the exact error is because I don't get the problem.
**I simulate the whole design with MentorGraphics Questa and there it works without any problem. So it seems to be a problem with the Synthesis tool.**
Kind regards and thank you very much for helping!
Sebastian

The synthesis error strongly points to a **SystemVerilog semantic/tool-compatibility issue** in `stream_register.sv`:

- `DATA_WIDTH ($size(T))` is likely invalid when `T` is a **type parameter** that is not an unpacked array type.
- Synplify is strict here (`Expecting array type`), while Questa is more permissive in simulation.
- The likely intent is bit-width of type `T`, which is `$bits(T)`, not `$size(T)`.

However, this may ripple beyond one line:
1. `stream_register` delegates behavior to a FIFO implementation (`fifo_v2` in deprecated path), so width/type handling there may also need updates or assertions.
2. Similar stream/register/FIFO wrappers may contain the same `$size(type)` pattern and should be normalized for synthesis portability.
3. Build/source-manifest files may require updates if the fix includes switching FIFO implementations or deprecating problematic variants.

Most likely files to edit are:

``` 
./src/stream_register.sv
./src/deprecated/fifo_v2.sv
./src/fifo_v3.sv
./src/stream_fifo.sv
